$comment: Hook wiring snippet to paste into the target repo's .claude/settings.json. Merge with existing blocks; do not overwrite the whole file.

PreToolUse.$comment: GENERATED artifact protection (dim 14 enforcement × dim 8): runs BEFORE Write/Edit and BLOCKS when the destination matches a generated-artifact pattern of the target (protectedGlobs). 'Can block? Yes': PreToolUse runs before the tool and cancels it. Modern form = hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision:'deny' + permissionDecisionReason (exit 0); wins even under bypassPermissions. Legacy form = exit 2 + stderr (denyMode:'exit2'); NEVER mix the two (the docs: JSON is ignored when exit 2). The reason is ACTIONABLE: it names the SOURCE-OF-TRUTH to edit instead of the generated artifact ('X defines Y' rule). protectedGlobs/sourceHint are DERIVED from the target (hooks-config.json), NEVER paths from this repo; empty list = hook inert. Complements PostToolUse propose-docs-home (which PROPOSES after): this one BLOCKS before.

hooks.$comment: docs/ coverage (Step 8, triggered by EVENT): when Write/Edit touches a file under docs/, checks the touched file against the canonical taxonomy (the SAME block-2b criteria: VARIANT/TWO-HOMES/NO-HOME/NO-SIDECAR/NO-LABEL) and only PROPOSES the fix via additionalContext. NEVER blocks (PostToolUse does not undo the edit; 'Can block? No'). exit 0 always; stdout does NOT become context in this event, so the proposal goes via JSON additionalContext. Internal latency ceiling.

Config-surface guard (Step 8, .claude/ slice of the event trigger): when Write/Edit touches the harness itself (.claude/skills|agents|hooks|settings*.json), re-applies the cheap dims-6/7/8 checks to the touched artifact (frontmatter present, name==folder, description-as-trigger, orphan/dangling wiring 8b) and only PROPOSES via additionalContext. NEVER blocks; exit 0 always. Sibling of propose-docs-home (that one covers docs/); distinct from audit-config-change (ConfigChange, records metadata) and protect-generated (PreToolUse, blocks).

SessionStart.$comment: Compact-survival (Step 8): RE-INJECTS the stable layer (conventions/FQNs/guardrails/boundaries) that /compact would erase. Reads from a target-derived source (conventionsFile, or head of the root CLAUDE.md), NEVER a fixed list. Matcher covers compact/clear/resume; NOT startup (use the native CLAUDE.md). stdout becomes context; exit 0 always.

hooks.$comment: Automatic freshness (Step 8): only PROPOSES knowledge deltas (additionalContext), NEVER blocks. exit 0 always; stop_hook_active guard; internal latency ceiling.

Pre-completion validation (THIN hook THAT CALLS the script): at end of turn, runs the target-DERIVED validator (runValidation.validateScript/validateCmd in hooks-config.json) on ALTERED files (git status --porcelain, filtered by includeGlobs). The hook does NOT contain the logic: it lives in a scripts/checks|ci of the target. Default empty = INERT. Example for a Python repo (FORM only, never hardcoded): the scripts/checks/<validate> runs ruff check --fix + ruff format + pyright. Default PROPOSES the result via additionalContext (exit 0; ruff --fix mutates CODE files, not the base — so it informs, does not block); blockOnFail:true mode (off by default) uses decision:block for 'mandatory/never skip'. stop_hook_active guard; latency ceiling.

ConfigChange.$comment: Audit-trail (3rd lifecycle hook): RECORDS who/when/what changed on the surface itself (settings/skills) in a target log, append-only, metadata only (never the content — it may contain secrets). Matcher covers the 5 sources; OBSERVES, never blocks (exit 0 always, unlike exit 2 which would veto the change). stdout does NOT become context in this event; so it writes to a file. Destination is derived from the target (auditLog).
